 Abu Dhabi T10 2026 Match predictions: UAE Bulls vs United Tigers and Emirates Eagles vs Yas Lions – 18 November

 By Cricket World Staff 
 Wednesday 18 November 2026 
 Abu Dhabi T10 League 
 T10 series Schedule 26th Match, Abu Dhabi Live UAE Bulls 98/6 10 ov United Tigers 48/6 7.1 ov UNT need 51 runs in 17 remaining balls
 United Tigers elected to bowl
 Live scores and commentary 
 27th Match, Abu Dhabi Wed 18 Nov Emirates Eagles Yas Lions Wed 18 Nov, 16:00 GMT 
 The Abu Dhabi T10 2026 continues on Wednesday, 18 November, with two more matches on the schedule as the tournament's fast-paced cricket action gathers momentum.
 Here are the Predictions for Abu Dhabi T10 2026, 26th Match - UAE Bulls vs United Tigers and 27th Match - Emirates Eagles vs Yas Lions, to be played on the 18th of November at the Zayed Cricket Stadium, Abu Dhabi.
 Points Table 
 26th Match - UAE Bulls vs United Tigers (Zayed Cricket Stadium, Abu Dhabi) 
 Ground Stat:
Average 1st Innings Total at Zayed Cricket Stadium, Abu Dhabi (Abu Dhabi T10) - 116
Average 2nd Innings Total at Zayed Cricket Stadium, Abu Dhabi (Abu Dhabi T10) - 105
 Current Form UAE Bulls:
 UAE Bulls are currently placed at the 5th position on points table with 3 wins and 5 losses to their credit. They have 6 points to their name.
The top run scorer for UAE Bulls in the Abu Dhabi T10 League is Andre Fletcher with 200 runs to his name. 
The top wicket taker for UAE Bulls in the Abu Dhabi T10 League is Mohammad Amir with 9 scalps under his belt. 
 UAE Bulls have won their previous match against Royal Desert Champions by 6 wickets. 
Royal Desert Champions batted first and they posted a total of 131 for 1 in 10 overs. Brandon King and Nicholas Pooran started off very well for Royal Desert Champions. They stitched a partnership of 40 runs for the 1st wicket. After Pooran got out, King and Sherfane Rutherford provided a great finish for the innings. King made 60 while Rutherford scored 38 off 20 deliveries as Royal Desert Champions managed to reach a total of 131 in 10 overs of play.
During the chase, UAE Bulls couldn't get off to an ideal start and they were reduced to 43 for 3 in the 6th over itself. Just when things looked impossible, Shadab Khan played a T10 innings of a lifetime. He smashed 76 runs off just 21 deliveries, collecting 4 fours and 9 sixes. On the back of his brilliance with the bat, UAE Bulls managed to get over the line in the 10th over itself with 6 wickets in hand.
 Current Form United Tigers:
 United Tigers are currently placed at the 2nd position on points table with 5 wins and 3 losses to their credit. They have 10 points to their name.
The top run scorer for United Tigers in the Abu Dhabi T10 League is Fakhar Zaman with 225 runs to his name. 
The top wicket taker for United Tigers in the Abu Dhabi T10 League is Azmatullah Omarzai with 7 scalps under his belt. 
 United Tigers have lost their previous match against Arabian Aces by 7 wickets. 
United Tigers batted first and they posted a total of 103 for 5 in 10 overs. Sahibzada Farhan, Fakhar Zaman and Joe Clarke all got out without troubling the scorers much. After that phase, Iftikhar Ahmed played some really nice strokes and scored 46 runs off 24 balls, hitting 3 fours and 4 sixes. On the back of his brilliance with the bat, United Tigers managed to get past the 100 run mark, finishing at 103 in 10 overs of play.
During the chase, Arabian Aces lost the key wicket of Paul Walter quite early. After his dismissal, Moeen Ali and Sam Billings batted really well. Ali made 34 off 17 balls while Billings scored 31 runs in 11 deliveries. Andre Russell also contributed healthily with a whirlwind knock of 22 as Arabian Aces got over the line in the 9th over with 7 wickets in hand.

 27th Match - Emirates Eagles vs Yas Lions (Zayed Cricket Stadium, Abu Dhabi) 
 Ground Stat: 
Average 1st Innings Total at Zayed Cricket Stadium, Abu Dhabi (Abu Dhabi T10) - 116
Average 2nd Innings Total at Zayed Cricket Stadium, Abu Dhabi (Abu Dhabi T10) - 105
 Current Form Yas Lions:
 Yas Lions are currently placed at the 3rd position on points table with 5 wins and 3 losses to their credit . They have 10 points to their name.
The top run scorer for Yas Lions in the Abu Dhabi T10 League is Dasun Shanaka with 198 runs to his name. 
The top wicket taker for Yas Lions in the Abu Dhabi T10 League is Jason Holder with 10 scalps under his belt. 
 Yas Lions have won their previous match against Arabian Aces by 5 wickets. 
Arabian Aces batted first and they posted a total of 145 for 2 in 10 overs. Paul Walter and Moeen Ali failed this time around and got out after getting the starts. After their dismissals, Sam Billings and Liam Livingstone came into their own. Billings made 78 off 25 balls, collecting 5 fours and 8 sixes while Livingstone scored 37 off 18 balls to help Arabian Aces get to a highly competitive total of 145 in 10 overs of play.
During the chase, Yas Lions got off to a very ideal start. Their openers James Vince and Andries Gous collected 95 runs for the 1st wicket partnership and sealed the deal in favor of Yas Lions. Vince made 38 runs while Gous played a major role in keeping Yas Lions ahead of the game. He scored 72 runs in 24 balls, hitting 3 fours and 8 sixes. On the back of his brilliance with the bat, Yas Lions chased the target down in the last over with 5 wickets in hand.
 Current Form Emirates Eagles:
 Emirates Eagles are currently placed at the 4th position on points table with 4 wins and 4 losses to their credit. They have 8 points to their name.
The top run scorer for Emirates Eagles in the Abu Dhabi T10 League is Shimron Hetmyer with 300 runs to his name. 
The top wicket taker for Emirates Eagles in the Abu Dhabi T10 League is Haider Razzaq with 10 scalps under his belt. 
 Emirates Eagles have won their previous match against Royal Desert Champions by 8 wickets. 
Royal Desert Champions batted first and they posted a total of 110 for 4 in 10 overs. Brandon King and Nicholas Pooran started off very well for Royal Desert Champions. They added 51 runs for the 1st wicket partnership. King made 29 off 18 balls while Pooran scored 51 off 23 deliveries. After these two got out, Sherfane Rutherford consumed too many deliveries for his knock of 17 runs which didn't help the team much and Royal Desert Champions had to settle for a total of 110 in 10 overs of play.
During the chase, Emirates Eagles lost the key wicket of Alex Hales quite early into the innings. After his dismissal, Kyle Mayers and Shimron Hetmyer took the responsibility of taking Emirates Eagles over the line. Mayers made 34 off 20 balls while Hetmyer scored 59 runs in 25 deliveries, collecting 6 fours and 4 sixes. On the back of these brilliant batting performances, Emirates Eagles got home in the 9th over itself with 8 wickets in hand.
